tex_content.html:
Proposition
[determination by the first jet]

Source: petersen:page-0329 ↗ def:pet-ch8-killing-field ↗ prop:pet-ch8-killing-skew-symmetric 1. ch8:8.1.4For a given $p\in M$, a Killing field $X\in \iso (M,g)$ is uniquely determined by $X|_p$ and $( abla X)|_p$. In particular there is a short exact sequence \[ 0 o \iso _p o \iso (M,g) o t_p o 0, \] where $\iso _p=\{ X\in \iso (M,g)\mid X|_p=0\} $ and $t_p=\{ X|_p\in T_pM\mid X\in \iso (M,g)\} $.
Proof

↗ prop:pet-ch8-killing-uniqueness \sketch Along every geodesic $c$, an infinitesimal isometric variation makes $X|_c$ a Jacobi field. Consequently $X(p)=0$ and $( abla X)_p=0$ force $X$ to vanish on a normal neighborhood of $p$; continuation over the connected manifold gives $X=0$. Therefore $X\mapsto (X_p,( abla X)_p)$ is injective. The evaluation map $\iso (M,g) o T_pM$ has kernel $\iso _p$ and image $t_p$, which proves exactness of the displayed sequence.

□
